maddeler.e: قَنْجَة • (qanja) f (plural قَنْجَات (qanjāt) or قِنَاج (qināj) or قَنْجِيَّات (qanjiyyāt))
maddeler.t: Shortened from Ottoman Turkish قانجهباش (kancabaş, “ship of a curved prow”) from قانجه (kanca, “hook”) + باش (baş, “prow”), so called because of its prow being curved like a hook.
s: Ottoman Turkish قانجهباش (kancabaş, “ship of a curved prow”)
g: a kind of sailing boat of up to two masts used for housing and for pleasure-trips, for example on the Nile by sultans or rented by upper-class Britons
